prediction_text: Direction: Biden wins the election and does take the presidency — but only after a contested aftermath. Trump refuses to concede, alleges fraud over mail-in voting, and pursues legal challenges; the transfer is delayed and turbulent, with civil unrest, yet Biden is inaugurated in January 2021 and Trump leaves office. Two-stage: near stage disputed count and litigation (Nov-Dec 2020), far stage confirmed transfer (Jan 2021).
